exact_binary_sources.title: 2023 Qualified Allocation Plan Comments and Responses

official_page_findings.description: The live LIHTC page states a calendar-year 2015 territorial allocation of $2,680,000 and does not publish a current allocation figure.
The page says maximum income and rent limits are published annually by VIHFA, but no current limit schedule is linked on the page.

The page states that properties receive annual tenant-file monitoring and physical inspections during the 15-year compliance period, but no compliance manual, inspection procedure, owner certification, TIC, student form or lease addendum is linked.

blocking_conflicts.description: The live page links a final 2015 QAP and a file/page-label combination that still identifies the 2023 document as a draft; evidence of the currently adopted QAP is missing.
The comment-response document describes final changes, but the resulting adopted, governor-approved QAP is not linked and cannot be reconstructed from comments alone.
No current VIHFA income and rent limit schedule was linked; property figures must be independently verified against HUD and applicable territorial authority.
No current compliance manual, monitoring instructions, annual owner certification, tenant certification, student form, lease addendum or waiver procedure was linked.
The live program page still states a 2015 tax-credit allocation amount and must not be treated as current program funding data.

enterprise_boundary: Only blank official forms and adopted public guidance belong in this shared pack. Completed tenant files, owner submissions, Forms 8609, extended-use agreements, waivers, utility schedules and inspection records remain enterprise/property records.
activation_requirements: Currently adopted and governor-approved QAP with exact binary identity
Current income and rent limit schedule with HUD reconciliation
Current compliance manual, inspection procedures and official blank forms
Byte-derived content validation and page-level deterministic rule citations
Resolved source, scope, currency and supersession conflicts
Positive, negative, boundary, layered-program and supersession fixtures
Independent compliance-expert approval bound to the exact release
Enterprise VP Compliance property-figure verification at onboarding
